S.2. Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.P.S.B. REGISTRY. No. D 4527. Date 24 February 33）
Date ____

Subject (in full) Economical Section of Centrosojus reported to be connecting link between the Soviet G.P.U. and the Chinese Communist Party.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

Information from a reliable source indicates that the Economical Section of the local branch of the Centrosojus, No.2 Peking Road, is the centre of Soviet economical espionage in China and is the connecting link between the Soviet G.P.U. and a certain branch of the Chinese Communist Party.

Boris Pavlovitch Kozloff, 27, Russian, manager of the Economical Section, arrived in Shanghai from Harbin via Dairen on February 17, 1933, by the s.s. "Hoten Maru", accompanied by his wife and child. He holds a "Service Passport" issued by the "Commissariat for Foreign Affairs" at Moscow. Kozloff is a graduate of the Lazarevsky Institute of Oriental Languages in Moscow and speaks fluent Chinese. It is reported that he frequently meets certain Chinese communists, many of whom are returned students from U.S.S.R. Some visit his house, but he usually meets them in gardens, theatres and other public places. In Harbin, Kozloff's wife took an active part in the work of both the Russian and Chinese Communist Parties. While in Harbin she was employed with the Chinese Eastern Railway. Kozloff, following his arrival here took up residence at Flat 23, Park Apartments, 455 Rue Lafayette, where he resided until recently when he removed to Passage No.125, House 41, Verdun Terrace, Avenue du Roi Albert, which is owned by one H.W. Holland.

Kozloff's assistant is one N.M. Lifanoff, aged 28, Russian, who arrived in Shanghai from Dairen by the s.s. "Hoten Maru", accompanied by his wife, on May 9, 1932. He is a graduate of the Lazarevsky Institute of Oriental Languages in Moscow and is a fairly good Chinese scholar. 主题（全称）据报苏联消费合作社中央联社（Centrosojus）经济处是苏联国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）与中国共产党之间的联络纽带。

撰写人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人：[签名]

来自可靠渠道的情报显示，位于北京路2号的苏联消费合作社中央联社本地分支机构的经济处，是苏联在华经济间谍活动的中心，也是苏联国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）与中国共产党某分支之间的联络纽带。

鲍里斯·帕夫洛维奇·科兹洛夫（Boris Pavlovitch Kozloff），27岁，俄国人，经济处处长，于1933年2月17日携妻儿乘坐“Hoten Maru”号轮船，经大连从哈尔滨抵达上海。他持有莫斯科“外交人民委员部”签发的“公务护照”。科兹洛夫毕业于莫斯科拉扎列夫东方语言学院，中文流利。据报他经常与某些中国共产党员会面，其中许多人是留苏归国学生。有些人会去他家拜访，但他通常会在花园、剧院和其他公共场所与他们见面。在哈尔滨期间，科兹洛夫的妻子积极参与了俄国和中国共产党的工作。在哈尔滨时，她受雇于中东铁路。科兹洛夫抵沪后，居住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）455号公园公寓（Park Apartments）23室，直至最近搬至阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）凡尔登台（Verdun Terrace）41号125弄，该房产归一名叫 H.W. Holland 的人所有。

科兹洛夫的助手是 N.M. Lifanoff，28岁，俄国人，于1932年5月9日携妻子乘坐“Hoten Maru”号轮船从大连抵达上海。他毕业于莫斯科拉扎列夫东方语言学院，中文造诣尚可。据报数年前他曾受雇于《满洲监视报》（Manchuria Monitor），该报是中东铁路的官方刊物。在

COMMISSIONER
September 3, 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4524
Morning Translation 9/33

MISCELLANEOUS

The Sin Wan Pao:-

S.M.C. WARNS SIN YIA MEDICINE FACTORY

The S.M.C. yesterday sent a warning to the
Sin Yia Chemicals Manufacturing Factory to improve its
equipment.
The Factory immediately sent a letter to
the Federation of the Machine-made National Products
Factories asking for assistance.
The Federation investigated the equipment
of the Factory and found it adequate. The S.M.C.
is regarded as improperly interfered with the Factory.
The Federation will send a representative
to the S.M.C. to-morrow morning to open negotiations.
The Federation has sent a circular letter to
the various public bodies to render assistance in the
negotiations.

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

CENTROSOJUS ENTERTAINS NEWSPAPERMEN

The local branch of the Centrosojus gave
a dinner to reporters of the various local newspapers
at noon yesterday at the Tu Chen Restaurant, Foochow
Road. Some 30 foreign and Chinese newspapermen were
present.
"Makoff", Chairman of the Federation, spoke
on the organization of the Federation and refuted the
rumours that the Federation had been established to
undertake political intrigues.

The Shun Pao:-

SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR YELLOW RIVER FLOOD REFUGEES

The Federation organized by the various local
benevolent organs to solicit funds for the Yellow River
flood victims held a meeting at 4 p.m. yesterday.
Many prominent citizens were elected as committee members.

The Shun Pao:-

VOLUNTEER COMMANDER IN SHANGHAI SOLICIT SUBSCRIPTIONS

General Chen Yung, former chairman of the
Kirin Provincial Government, and commander of the Kirin
National Salvation volunteers, who arrived in Shanghai
sometime ago to participate in the auditing
of the national salvation funds, had an interview with
a reporter of this paper yesterday, during which he stated
that the public should not cease sending subscriptions
so that the Northern volunteers might not have to give
up their resistance against the Japanese.

杂项

《新闻报》：

工部局警告新亚药厂

工部局昨日向新亚化学制药厂发出警告，要求其改进设备。
该厂立即致函国货工厂联合会请求援助。
联合会调查了该厂的设备，发现其符合要求。工部局被视为不当干涉该厂。
联合会将于明晨派代表前往工部局展开谈判。
联合会已向各公共团体发出通函，请求在谈判中提供协助。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

苏联消费合作社中央联社宴请报界人士

苏联消费合作社中央联社本地分支机构昨日中午在福州路都陈餐厅（Tu Chen Restaurant）宴请各本地报纸记者。约有30名中外记者出席。
联合会主席“马科夫”（Makoff）就联合会的组织情况发表了讲话，并驳斥了关于该联合会成立旨在从事政治阴谋的谣言。

《申报》：

为黄河水灾难民募捐

由各本地慈善机构组织的为黄河水灾受害者募款的联合会于昨日下午4时举行会议。许多知名市民当选为委员会委员。

《申报》：

在沪义勇军指挥官募集捐款

前吉林省政府主席、吉林国民救国义勇军指挥官陈勇将军，此前抵沪参与审核救国基金，昨日接受本报记者采访，期间他表示，公众不应停止捐款，以免北方义勇军被迫放弃抗日抵抗。
